body.proof_tex: The computable surrogate is already complete. By \(\mathrm{prop:polynomial\text{-}net\text{-}law\text{-}estimator}\), \(\widehat\lambda_n\) is a total, positive, real-law-valued estimator obtained by exhaustive minimization over a lattice of cardinality polynomial in \(n\) for fixed \(k,d_x,d_z\). By \(\mathrm{thm:honest\text{-}root\text{-}n\text{-}confidence}\), \(\mathcal C^{\mathrm{alg}}_{n,\alpha}\) is honest and has \(W_1\)-diameter at most \(2R_{n,\alpha}\). By \(\mathrm{def:cluster\text{-}report}\) and \(\mathrm{thm:cluster\text{-}adaptive\text{-}report}\), every reported interval \(I_C\) and the full report \(\mathfrak R_{n,\alpha}\) have explicit fixed-dimensional constrained-program representations with the stated support and mass guarantees. Hence an evaluable honest outer set and report exist even for summaries with nonreal raw empirical spectra; only exact computation of the original sharper summary-inversion image and its exact extrema remains unresolved.
body.justification: Only exact or sharp computation of the original summary-inversion image and its exact extrema remains open.
body.gap: The explicit outer confidence set and report do not provide a finite representation of the admissible-summary closure or black-box extension image.
body.consumer: A solution would sharpen computation of the original theoretical object, not supply the already-available evaluable outer report.
